**Describe the bug**
Include detailed steps to reproduce. If the bug occurs with specific URNs, **include the URNs**.
Issues that occur on specific pages that do not include links or a screenshot to those pages
will be closed.

**(Optional) Screenshot**
Include a screenshot (if applicable). Your screenshot should show the full window, including
the full URL of the page on which the bug occurred.

**(Optional) Propose a fix**
If there is a resolution that you would like to see, please feel free to propose it here.
